Install HCM Coach

HCM Coach is a Chrome extension. It lives in your browser and opens in a side panel beside Oracle, so step-by-step help for every HCM process is always one click away. It cannot see or change the pages you work on.

Time: about 5 minutesVersion: 0.5.0Updated: November 20, 2026

Before you start

Google ChromeVersion 116 or newer, on your work computer.
The install filehcm-coach-0.5.0.zip, from the HCM Academy team.
Your access codeFrom your HCM Academy contact. You enter it once, with your name and work email.
Already have Coachmark or an older HCM Coach? Remove it first (step 2, then Remove on its card) so you do not have two.

Install it

  1. Unzip the file and keep the folder

    • Windows: right-click hcm-coach-0.5.0.zip › Extract All › Extract.
    • Mac: double-click the zip file.

    You now have a folder named hcm-coach. Move it somewhere it will stay, such as Documents.

    Keep this folder. Chrome runs HCM Coach from it. If you move, rename or delete it, HCM Coach stops working.

  2. Open Chrome's Extensions page

    In Chrome's address bar, type chrome://extensions and press Enter. (Or open the ⋮ menu › Extensions › Manage Extensions.)

  3. Turn on Developer mode, then click Load unpacked

    Switch on Developer mode in the top-right corner (1). A row of buttons appears. Click Load unpacked (2).

  4. Choose the hcm-coach folder

    In the window that opens, go to where you put the folder, click hcm-coach once to select it, then click Select (Windows: Select Folder). The HCM Coach 0.5.0 live card appears (3), switched on.

    Pick the folder, not the zip. Choose the hcm-coach folder itself, the one that contains manifest.json.

  5. Pin HCM Coach to your toolbar

    Click the puzzle-piece icon to the right of the address bar, then click the pin next to HCM Coach. The gold V icon now stays on your toolbar.

  6. Open it and set it up

    Click the gold V icon. HCM Coach opens in the side panel on the right of whatever page you are on. Read the welcome and click Got it. Show me the lessons.

    A one-minute tour plays first (you can skip it). Then enter your name, your work email and your access code, and click Start. You only do this once. HCM Academy uses it to track your training progress.

Using HCM Coach

Pick a process. Search or tap a topic, choose the process, and press Start. Each step tells you what to do, where to look and what you should see. You do the work in Oracle, then press Done. Next step. Stuck on a step? Press Give me a hint.

Ask. Click Ask at the bottom right of the panel and type a question. The coach answers only from the guides and job aids inside HCM Coach, and shows where the answer came from.

Keeping it up to date

New and changed processes

They arrive on their own the next time you open the panel. To check right away, click Check for updates under Guide content.

A new version of the app

If you are sent a new zip: unzip it, replace the contents of your hcm-coach folder with the new files, then on chrome://extensions click the reload arrow ⟳ on the HCM Coach card.

If something goes wrong

What you seeWhat to do
No Developer mode switch, or Load unpacked is missing or greyed outYour Chrome is set up by IT to block this kind of install. Contact your HCM Academy contact; IT may need to allow HCM Coach.
Manifest file is missing or unreadableThe wrong folder was chosen. Repeat step 4 and pick the hcm-coach folder that contains manifest.json, not the zip and not the folder above it.
Clicking the icon does not open the panelRight-click the gold V icon and choose Open side panel. Make sure Chrome is version 116 or newer (⋮ › Help › About Google Chrome).
That access code is not right.Check the code with your HCM Academy contact and type it again on the setup screen.
HCM Coach vanished or shows an error after a restartThe hcm-coach folder was moved or deleted. Put it back, or unzip again and repeat steps 3 and 4.
You see two HCM Coach (or Coachmark) iconsOn chrome://extensions, click Remove on the older one.

What it can and cannot do

It can

  • Show step-by-step guidance in Chrome's side panel
  • Download new and updated guides, using your access code
  • Send HCM Academy your training progress: your name, work email and each step's help level
  • Keep your notes in this browser

It cannot

  • See, read or change Oracle or any other page
  • Send your screen or anything from Oracle
  • Send your call notes or ratings anywhere
